assert before[LOG.name]['git_blob']=='7c304e85f7f60ad837ca906eaacc091a0d936c2d'

lines=[re.sub(r'\x1b\[[0-9;]*m','',re.sub(r'^\d{4}-\d\d-\d\dT\S+Z ','',s)) for s in raw.splitlines()]
def refs(predicate):return [{'line':i+1,'text':l} for i,l in enumerate(lines) if predicate(l)]
checkout=refs(lambda l:l.endswith('git log -1 --format=%H'))
assert len(checkout)==1 and lines[checkout[0]['line']]==G
objects=[]

report_line,r=reports[0]

cache=r['cache_reuse']
assert cache['expected_offered_reads']==cache['recorded_offered_reads']==cache['validated_reads']==2400
assert cache['errors']==[] and cache['temporal_cache_coverage']
assert len(cache['time_quarters'])==4
assert sum(q['reads'] for q in cache['time_quarters'])==2400
assert sum(q['hits'] for q in cache['time_quarters'])==cache['observed']['hit']
assert sum(q['misses'] for q in cache['time_quarters'])==cache['observed']['miss']
assert sum(q['invalidations'] for q in cache['time_quarters'])==cache['observed']['invalidations']
assert all(x=={'success':2400} for x in cache['request_counts'].values())

build_line,build=builds[0]

ordinary=[c for c in checks if int(re.search(r'/actions/runs/(\d+)',c['details_url'])[1]) in run_ids]
assert len(ordinary)==26 and all(c['head_sha']==G and c['status']=='completed' and c['conclusion']=='success' for c in ordinary)
assert {c['id'] for c in ordinary}=={c['id'] for c in snapshot['ordinary_scope']['checks']}
assert snapshot['main_ref']=='30a6dff579c88593c1762db244eacbe6ee95cef9'
bridges=json.loads(BRIDGE.read_text())['testmerge_bridges']
bridge=next(x for x in bridges if x['parents'][0]==snapshot['main_ref'])
assert bridge['tree']==TREE and bridge['parents'][1]==G
